name: Elemental Boost
body:
School enchantment; Level druid/shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target living creature touched
Duration 1 round/4 caster levels
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell allows you to add 1d6 extra damage to a spell, spell-like, or special ability with an elemental damage component (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) for every 4 caster levels you possesses for the duration of the spell.

All other effects and components of the spell or ability remain the same.
